yt_title: How to back up your Instagram saved reels
caption:
You saved 500. Download them.

How to back up your Instagram saved reels:

1. Profile, menu, Accounts Center.
2. Your information and permissions, Download your information (some accounts say Export).
3. Some of your information, tick only Saved.
4. Download to device, All time, HTML.
Instagram emails it, usually within hours.

Then drop the zip into SaveSort to sort every save by topic. No file yet? Try the sample report.

Save this for when you need the steps.

Sorty's voice is AI. Our sample report (156 saves) is real.
